messages:
Nora (PM): Quick sync: drafting a long-term routing + tenant isolation roadmap. Goal: concrete launch gates and a simple prioritization rubric. Link: https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/route-isolation-canvas

Diego (Eng): Read it. We should be explicit about cache isolation guarantees and KV eviction semantics for isolated lanes. Those are the trickiest perf regressions.

Yara (Infra): Agree. For multi-region offers we need automated data plane provisioning + KMS boundary checks. Networking onboarding is usually >50% of infra time for customers.

Len (SRE): Ops note: Require an evacuation playbook and a staging disaster drill before any GA for isolated tenants. Also need observability per-tenant at least for latency and error budgets.

Priya (Sales): Two enterprise prospects want regional residency + dedicated lanes. One will only sign with VPC+KMS. We should put that as high priority.

Nora (PM): Draft launch gates I propose: 1) Performance SLOs (p95 under committed load), 2) KMS + audit logs, 3) Network onboarding automation, 4) Ops runbook + drill. Which are blockers?

Diego (Eng): Blockers: performance SLOs and KV cache correctness. Non-blocker: billing UI polish.

Yara (Infra): Blockers: KMS handshake automation and infra template for VPC onboarding. Also suggest a minimum commit threshold (e.g., sustained token throughput or reserved GPU count) to allocate isolated infra.

Len (SRE): Blocker: runbook automation + alerting playbooks. We can tolerate staged rollout but need canary + rollback.

Priya (Sales): Prioritization rubric suggestion: Revenue impact 45%, Compliance/regulatory 25%, Implementation complexity 20%, Time-to-value 10%. This ranks the VPC/KMS asks top.

Nora (PM): I'll harmonize the two rubrics and include an "operational cost delta" factor. Proposed phases: Phase A = Private single-region tenants + KMS; Phase B = cross-region replication + evacuation automation; Phase C = self-serve reserved lanes + pricing model.

Yara (Infra): Rough timelines: A = 6-10w, B = 8-12w, C = 4-6w (console work).

Len (SRE): Ops readiness gate per phase required. We'll provide drill schedule and runbook templates.

Priya (Sales): I'll prepare customer-facing onramp commitments for two P1s; need phase A gates locked.

Nora (PM): Action items: Nora update doc with gates & rubric (due Thu); Diego prototype eviction-safe cache changes (2w); Yara draft VPC/KMS onboarding template + capacity thresholds (next Wed); Len provide ops checklist + drill plan (Mon); Priya draft onramp commit for customers (next Wed).

deploy-bot: Scheduled: routing-canary v1.2 -> staging at 2024-06-12T09:00:00Z

Diego (Eng): We'll add the canary test matrix. Nora, please ping when doc updated. End.
